t: Input and output devices and sensors

data-representation: Web colours look like #FF8C00. Why letters and numbers?
data-transmission: How does a video arrive in order if its pieces take different routes?
hardware: ENIAC took days to reprogram. Your phone swaps apps instantly. Why?
input-output-devices-sensors: Your phone screen feels your finger but not your glove. Why?
software: One CPU core, three apps at once. How is that possible?
the-internet-its-uses: Routers only use numbers. How does a typed web address find its site?
automated-emerging-technologies: Nobody touches the greenhouse. So what turns the water on?
algorithm-design-problem-solving: Why does the Tube map ignore real distances, yet still work?
programming: How does a game turn 135 seconds into 2:15 on its timer?
databases: Two students called Amy Khan: how does a database tell them apart?
boolean-logic: "Tea or coffee?" Would a computer's OR let you have both?
